text:
alex: quick sync: spike findings for automatic rollback/reentry. idea: introduce a tiny 'circuit shepherd' layer that orchestrates reentry attempts and enforces global pacing so we never get mass re-enables.

priya: shepherd? like a separate reentry gate between policy and router?

alex: exactly. policy-service decides action (HOLD/RETRY/OPEN), shepherd coordinates timed retries, token leases, and per-tenant jitter. keeps router dumb.

ben: operational constraints? we don't want extra latency on routing path.

alex: router calls policy-service (sync) for immediate decisions. if policy returns RETRY, router marks traffic unchanged and shepherd asynchronously schedules a tiny probe slice. router path stays fast.

margo: what about state? shepherd needs to track queued reentries and leases. where's that stored?

alex: two-tier: in-memory lease table in shepherd instances + compact checkpoint to durable store (Redis or customer adapter). entries are tiny (tenant, variant, lease_expires, attempt_id). TTLs + sharding keep memory bounded.

priya: spike numbers?

alex: sim: 50k tenants, 3 variants avg -> 150k potential entries, but steady-state queued < 2k. memory for lease table ~ 50MB with efficient encoding.

ben: failure modes? if shepherd loses checkpoint, can duplicates happen?

alex: we use idempotent attempt ids and optimistic skip-on-duplicate. also a coordinator with mild leader election to avoid dupe-scheduling.

policy-bot: note: recommend min_samples=10 for any auto-retry and a max_concurrent_retries per-tenant = 1

margo: UX asks: Console should show queued reentries and allow manual cancel/force. also show ETA per attempt.

priya: privacy: samples used for quality checks must follow customer sampling flag. if disallowed, rely on metrics-only and longer probe windows.

alex: thanks. next steps: implement shepherd prototype, wire policy-service responses, and add Console mock. 2-week spike. volunteers: @priya Console, @ben shepherd prototype, @margo logging/audit.

deploy-bot: shepherd-prototype v0.1 -> staging (sha:deadbeef) :rocket:
